race.comment: DUSKAURA (1) is progressing well and finds her race at start four. Indicated a win was imminent when closing late from back in the field to run second over 1400m Dubbo. Will race much closer from the draw and take holding out. OUR BULLY (10) much better effort at the big odds with a close up sixth over 1200m at Canberra two weeks ago. Drops in weight and finds a very this Maiden. MISS MAVERICK (9) remains a maiden after 28 runs. Like the way she found the line two back when second at Bathurst. Then disappointed with a tiring eighth over 1400m at Dubbo. Place only. FORWARDING (8) unlucky not to get the Maiden win out of the way and holding form this time in. Chased hard when second at Dubbo over 1300m. Senior rider hops aboard and keep safe. HOPE TO FLY (3) winkers go on third up and should appreciate the class drop after struggling on the provincial tracks.
